statement: This sketch depicts a continuous transformation from solid ice blocks into fluid pools on a dark floor. The ice blocks gradually shrink and lose their angular edges, evolving into smooth, shimmering blue liquid forms that spread outward. The process is animated to run continuously without user input, yet clicking anywhere on the canvas introduces localized heat that accelerates melting in nearby blocks. The visual effect emphasizes the interplay between form and fluidity, using WebGL rendering to create a 3D environment where translucent geometry morphs over time.
